item.title: Justice Department issues subpoenas to California election workers
item.description: Grand jury subpoenas sent to election workers in Los Angeles come amid escalating tensions between the Trump administration and California election officials over the state's voter rolls.

item.title: Trump returns to South Carolina as Senate race tightens
item.description: President Trump returned to South Carolina - the second time in eight days. The amount of attention and money its U.S. Senate race is getting is raising questions about how red the state really is.

item.description: New reporting alleging Democratic efforts to prop up a spoiler candidate has roiled Alaska's all-important U.S. Senate race.

item.title: On the campaign trail, Trump delivers his greatest political hits and mourns end of rallies
item.description: President Trump is campaigning hard in the midterms. Supporters are showing up, in part because this could be the last chance to see him holding the large rallies that have been his trademark.

item.title: Some rural Republicans in California say redistricting has left them without a voice
item.description: California's far northeastern corner used to be a reliably red congressional district. But Proposition 50 carved it up, meaning many voters there may soon have a Democrat representing them in D.C.

item.title: Fishing is a key issue in Alaska's tight U.S. Senate race
item.description: Alaska's U.S. Senate race is embroiled in an emotional fight over fish. Many in the state rely upon salmon to feed their families but those fish and others are increasingly hard to find.

item.title: GDP report to give insight before Election Day. And, Israel's election is deadlocked
item.description: Economists expect the GDP report to show economic growth, but say that growth is "fragile." And, after 90% of the votes in Israel have been counted, no clear winner has emerged.

item.title: Support for Trump among white evangelicals has plummeted, polls reveal
item.description: Three new polls suggest that President Trump is losing ground among white evangelicals. What explains this drop — and will it affect the midterm elections?
